subject: Compile the map: YaFF + HVM2 + Turso should generate executable WorkGraph closure, not documentation

body.objective: Make Generation-10 self-compiling. Architecture declarations must produce runnable obligations, tests, capability closure and proof gates.
required_actions: Parse the current YaFF/Atlas owner graph into typed capability terms: artifacts/claims/resources as values; Powers and graph owners as typed transformations; authority/resource/proof requirements as constraints.

Use the existing HVM2/rewrite substrate to explore equivalent capability compositions and collapse redundant paths. Cost candidate plans with ProviderGraph/MoneyGraph/ResourceGraph factors rather than choosing the first syntactic chain.
Persist compiled obligations, dependency identities, satisfaction state and invalidation keys in the existing Turso-backed durable state where available; do not create a parallel planner database.
Generate WorkGraph obligations only for uncovered or invalidated edges from the executable coverage matrix. A satisfied proof frontier must prune the generated graph.
Emit a plan witness showing source YaFF contract -> compiled typed graph -> selected composition -> executed owners -> proof addresses.
Feed novel successful compositions back into the map as candidate reusable macros without erasing the first-class native Power names they contain.
body.acceptance: Prove at least one real task whose compiled plan uses three or more named owners and where rewrite/cost selection chooses a different path than naive declaration order.
